## Agent Harnesses & Evaluation (2026‑08‑10)

### Plan‑Act‑Verify‑Recover Loops
- **OpenAI Instructzilla (2024)**  
  - Decomposes tasks into sub‑goals; agents plan, act, verify, and recover via dynamic feedback.  
  - Open‑sourced Q3 2024.  
  - Source: [OpenAI DeepResearch](https://www.openai.com/research/deep-research)  

- **Google DeepMind Iterative Critique (2024)**  
  - “Critique module” evaluates plan‑act sequences in simulated environments; iteratively refines strategies.  
  - Technical report June 2024.  
  - Source: [DeepMind Iterative Learning](https://www.deepmind.com/resources)  

### Sandboxed Tool Use
- **NVIDIA NeMo‑RL v2.0 (2024)**  
  - Isolated sandbox for API interaction; supports multi‑agent collaboration.  
  - Updated 2024.  
  - Source: [NeMo‑RL](https://developer.nvidia.com/nemo-rl)  

- **Hugging Face SafeRL (2024)**  
  - Open‑source sandbox for LLM‑based agents with tools (web scrapers, calculators).  
  - Built‑in regression suites for early failure detection.  
  - Source: Hugging Face SafeRL repository (no direct URL provided)  

- **AutoGPT‑Bench (2024‑11)**  
  - 150 end‑to‑end scenarios; nightly runs against released checkpoints.  
  - Flags any success‑rate drop > 2 %; failures logged to GitHub Actions board.  
  - Source: [AutoGPT‑Bench](https://github.com/auto-gpt/benchmark)  

- **LangChain Regression Hub (2025‑02)**  
  - Deterministic test vectors execute full plan‑act‑verify loops in sandbox (calculator, mock web‑search).  
  - JSON snapshots; deviations trigger Slack alerts.  
  - Source: [LangChain Regression Hub](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/tree/master/regression-hub)  

### Cost‑Aware Routing
- **Google Vertex AI Agent Cost Manager (2025‑01)**  
  - Dynamically switches between high‑capability LLM and lightweight decoder based on token‑cost forecast.  
  - Logs routing decisions to Cloud Monitoring dashboard.  
  - Source: [Vertex AI Cost Manager](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/agents/cost-management)  

- **Meta Cost‑Router (2024‑12)**  
  - Middleware that wraps external API calls; evaluates price‑performance, retries cheaper alternative if cost > $0.0001 per token.  
  - Benchmark: 34 % cost reduction, 92 % success‑rate preservation.  
  - Source: [Meta Cost‑Router](https://github.com/facebookresearch/cost-router)  

- **OpenAI Usage‑Optimized Routing (2025‑03)**  
  - Integrated into Assistants API; routes subtasks to “reasoning‑optimized” model only after low‑cost pass fails verification.  
  - Routing decisions recorded in usage logs for audit.  
  - Source: [OpenAI Routing Docs](https://platform.openai.com/docs/assistants/routing)  

### Evidence‑Driven Improvement Workflow  
*(Turning benchmark failures into scoped drills, retrieval updates, tool guidance, and repeatable regressions)*  

- **Detect failures** – Regression suites (AutoGPT‑Bench, LangChain Regression Hub) run nightly; flag deviations > 2 % success drop.  
- **Scoped drill** – Reproduce the exact failure in a sandboxed environment (NeMo‑RL, SafeRL) to isolate root cause.  
- **Retrieval update** – If failure linked to outdated data, refresh retrieval sources (e.g., update vector store, re‑index web scrapes).  
- **Tool guidance** – Adjust tool‑call logic using cost‑router or Vertex Cost Manager to avoid expensive or failing tools; apply retry policies.  
- **Repeatable regressions** – Capture the failure scenario in deterministic test vectors (LangChain Regression Hub) and add to CI/CD pipeline; re‑run on future releases to ensure no regression.  
- **Audit trail** – All decisions logged (Cost Manager dashboard, OpenAI usage logs, GitHub Actions board) for traceability and future analysis.  

These concrete practices turn benchmark failures into actionable, repeatable improvements for production‑grade AI agents.
